# D1 skeleton: what exists, what a node still needs.
# Written by tools/gen_d1_vectors.py; pinned by tests/d1_skeleton.rs.
phase=D0
exit_stub=2
exit_usage=64
exit_no_workspace=3
capabilities=7
capability=tx-pipeline D2 rpc -> mempool -> exec -> block -> consensus -> storage -> event
capability=mempool D3 nonce/balance/gas admission, `effective_tip` priority, eviction
capability=json-rpc D4 `submit_tx`, `get_balance`, `get_tx`, `get_block`, `call`, `estimate_gas`, `subscribe`
capability=grpc-rest D5 protobuf schema, gateway, OpenAPI, versioning
capability=metrics D6 Prometheus, `/health`, `/metrics`, OpenTelemetry traces
capability=devnet D7 `make devnet`: 4 validators, genesis, faucet key, logs
capability=cli D8 `aura` node ops, query, tx, keys, snapshot, upgrade
